steps: Take a free online course in Project Management (e.g., Google Project Management on Coursera) to build foundational skills.
Learn API design basics through a tutorial like 'REST API Design' on freeCodeCamp.
Explore ASP.NET and Azure via Microsoft Learn's free modules for web development.
Study BIM fundamentals with an introductory course on LinkedIn Learning or edX.
Gain practical experience by managing a small project at work or volunteering to lead a team.
